series.name: Association for Education Finance and Policy Annual Conference
series.organizer: Association for Education Finance and Policy (AEFP)
series.notes: Important dates at https://aefpweb.org/conference-dates. Submissions via Oxford Abstracts.

series.name: APPAM Fall Research Conference
series.organizer: Association for Public Policy Analysis & Management (APPAM)
series.associated_journal: Journal of Policy Analysis and Management
series.notes: Public policy conference (all policy areas). A separate Late-Breaking Roundtable call runs late August to late September.

series.name: SREE Conference
series.organizer: Society for Research on Educational Effectiveness (SREE)
series.associated_journal: Journal of Research on Educational Effectiveness
series.notes: Multidisciplinary education-research society (causal/evaluation research). Call pages follow the pattern https://www.sree.org/<year>-call.

series.name: Meeting of the Economics of Education Association (AEDE)
series.organizer: Asociación de Economía de la Educación (AEDE)
series.notes: Venue rotates (Spain, Portugal, Italy). Each edition has its own site, e.g. https://2026.economicsofeducation.com/en/.

series.name: International Workshop on Applied Economics of Education (IWAEE)
series.organizer: Magna Graecia University of Catanzaro, with Lancaster University and NTNU
series.notes: Held in Catanzaro (Calabria), Italy. 2026 fees: EUR 405, EUR 300 for PhD students.

series.name: LEER Conference on Education Economics
series.organizer: Leuven Economics of Education Research (LEER), KU Leuven
series.notes: Structured abstract of 200-300 words; oral and poster presentations.

series.name: NBER Summer Institute: Economics of Education
series.organizer: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)
series.notes: Submissions through the general NBER Summer Institute call, open to researchers with and without NBER affiliation.

series.name: NBER Conference on the Economics of Community Colleges
series.organizer: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), with support from Ascendium Education Philanthropy
series.notes: One-off NBER conference, 6-7 April 2028 in Cambridge, MA; papers to appear in a University of Chicago Press edited volume.

series.name: AEA Conference on Teaching and Research in Economic Education (CTREE)
series.organizer: American Economic Association, Committee on Economic Education (AEA-CEE)
series.notes: CTREE page URL changes by year (.../economic-education/ctree/<year>).

series.name: Developments in Economics Education Conference (DEE)
series.organizer: Economics Network (UK)
series.notes: Held in odd years in the UK; page URL changes by edition (economicsnetwork.ac.uk/dee<year>/).

series.name: TSE Economics of Education Workshop
series.organizer: Toulouse School of Economics (TSE)
series.notes: Editions in 2024 and 2025 only; no 2026 edition found, so the series may be paused. Contact educ.workshop@tse-fr.eu.

series.name: EAERE Annual Conference
series.organizer: European Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (EAERE)
series.notes: Non-members of EAERE may submit papers. No EAERE conference in World Congress years (2026, 2030); the 2027 conference is in Madrid.

series.name: World Congress of Environmental and Resource Economists (WCERE)
series.organizer: World Council of Environmental and Resource Economists Associations (WCEREA), incl. EAERE, AERE and AAERE
series.site_note: Each congress has its own website (2026: wcere2026.org), announced on the EAERE, AERE and AAERE sites. Search "WCERE 2030".
series.notes: 7th WCERE: Nova SBE, Carcavelos (Lisbon area), 29 Jun-3 Jul 2026. EAERE and AERE skip their own conferences in congress years.

series.name: AERE Summer Conference
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.associated_journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (JAERE)
series.notes: Abstract-based call; individual abstracts and complete session proposals. No 2026 conference because of WCERE 2026.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: AERE-organized sessions inside the ASSA/AEA Annual Meeting; separate call from the AEA general call. Abstracts of max. 300 words, up to two per presenting author.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Eastern Economic Association Annual Conference (AERE@EEA)
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the EEA meeting. Presenters must be AERE members for the conference year; no EEA submission fee for AERE@EEA papers.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the WEAI Annual Conference (AERE@WEAI)
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the WEAI meeting. Presenters must be AERE members for the conference year.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Midwest Economics Association Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the MEA meeting.

series.name: AERE Sessions at the Southern Economic Association Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (AERE)
series.notes: Separate AERE call for sessions within the SEA meeting (earlier than the SEA general deadline).

series.name: CREEA|ACERE Annual Conference (Canadian Resource and Environmental Economics)
series.organizer: Canadian Resource and Environmental Economics Association (CREEA|ACERE)
series.notes: Two streams: complete papers (longer slot with discussant) and extended abstracts (10-15 min talks). Hosted by a different Canadian university each year (2026: University of Waterloo).

series.name: AAERE Annual Congress (Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics; formerly EAAERE)
series.organizer: Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (AAERE)
series.notes: Successor of the East Asian Association of Environmental and Resource Economics (EAAERE; 8th Congress 2019); congress numbering continued under the AAERE name from 2021. Venue rotates across Asia; in scope only when held in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong or Singapore (2024 Hsinchu was in scope; 2025 Beijing and 2026 Jakarta were not).

series.name: AARES Annual Conference (Australasian Agricultural & Resource Economics Society)
series.organizer: Australasian Agricultural and Resource Economics Society (AARES)
series.associated_journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics (AJARE)
series.notes: Agricultural & resource economics society; included for its resource and environmental economics component. Each conference has its own site linked from aares.org.au (2027: aares2027.com); abstracts via Oxford Abstracts.

series.name: IAEE International Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE)
series.notes: Venue rotates worldwide; only editions in the dashboard regions are in scope. 2026 (47th, Santiago, Chile) and 2027 (48th, Nanjing, China, 15-18 Aug 2027) are out of scope.

series.name: IAEE European Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) with a national affiliate
series.notes: Organized with a national IAEE affiliate each year (2026 Munich; 2027 Madrid with AEEE).

series.name: USAEE/IAEE North American Conference
series.organizer: United States Association for Energy Economics (USAEE), affiliate of IAEE
series.notes: Individual works may be a full paper or an abstract only; full sessions also accepted. At least one author of an accepted presentation must register and attend in person.

series.name: IAEE Asia-Oceania Conference
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE)
series.notes: Venue rotates in Asia-Oceania; in scope only when held in Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia or New Zealand (e.g. 2020 Auckland). The 2026 (8th) edition was in Qingdao, China (out of scope).

series.name: IAEE Sessions at the ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) / USAEE
series.notes: IAEE-sponsored energy and environmental economics sessions inside the ASSA Annual Meeting; submissions via Oxford Abstracts; in-person only; at least one author of an accepted paper must be an IAEE member.

series.name: Mannheim Conference on Energy and the Environment (MCEE)
series.organizer: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research
series.notes: Submissions via pretalx; full papers preferred (extended abstracts of 1,000+ words accepted); one accepted paper per submitting author; presenters also discuss a paper.

series.name: Toulouse Conference on the Economics of Energy and Climate
series.organizer: Toulouse School of Economics (TSE) Energy and Climate Center
series.notes: Also listed on CEPR events. Contact: elecconf@tse-fr.eu.

series.name: Heartland Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop
series.organizer: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop at Illinois)
series.notes: Aims at networking for graduate students and early-career faculty (8-minute talks and posters) but is not student-only; registration capped at 80. The site removes the deadline once submissions close.

series.name: Occasional Workshop in Environmental and Resource Economics
series.organizer: UC Santa Barbara (Environmental Markets Lab and Department of Economics)
series.notes: Selective workshop founded in 1994 at UCSB.

series.name: Annual BIOECON Conference
series.organizer: BIOECON network (2026 hosted by University of Cambridge, Department of Land Economy)
series.notes: Complete papers only; special-session proposals (3-4 papers) by email to bioecon@bioecon-network.org. In-person only. 2026 presenter package GBP 320 incl. 2 nights at St John's College, Cambridge.

series.name: FAERE Annual Conference
series.organizer: French Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (FAERE)
series.notes: Full papers via sciencesconf.org; several submissions allowed but one presentation per person. Host university changes each year.

series.name: Monte Verità Conference on Sustainable Resource Use and Economic Dynamics (SURED)
series.organizer: University of Basel (founded at ETH Zurich)
series.notes: Held every two years at Monte Verità, Ascona (Switzerland); EAERE-supported.

series.name: Ulvön Conference on Environmental Economics
series.organizer: Centre for Environmental and Resource Economics (CERE), Umeå University and SLU
series.notes: Abstract submission via online form; strong PhD-student participation alongside senior researchers. 2025 fee EUR 500 (EUR 300 presenting PhD students) incl. food, lodging and transport from Umeå.

series.name: CESifo Area Conference on Energy and Climate Economics
series.organizer: CESifo (CESifo Network / ifo Institute)
series.notes: Primarily for CESifo network members; the 2023 call stated that submissions from non-network members would also be considered (check each call). Travel and accommodation of one speaker per accepted paper reimbursed (2026). A Junior Workshop on Energy and Climate Economics runs alongside.

series.name: POWER Conference on Energy Research and Policy
series.organizer: Energy Institute at Haas, UC Berkeley
series.notes: Paper submission guidelines are posted on the conference page each autumn (for 2027: "check back ... in October 2026").

series.name: IAERE Annual Conference
series.organizer: Italian Association of Environmental and Resource Economists (IAERE)
series.notes: Full papers or extended abstracts in English; host university changes each year.

series.name: AERNA Conference (Spanish-Portuguese Association of Natural Resource and Environmental Economics)
series.organizer: Asociación Hispano-Portuguesa de Economía de los Recursos Naturales y Ambientales (AERNA)
series.notes: Papers at an advanced stage or extended abstracts. Held in Spain or Portugal (2026: Universitat Jaume I, Castellón, jointly with the XIV Meeting on International Economics).

series.name: Nordic Annual Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop (NAERE)
series.organizer: Nordic host institution (2026: Stockholm Institute of Transition Economics, SITE, at the Stockholm School of Economics)
series.site_note: No permanent website found; each edition is posted by its host (2026: SITE at the Stockholm School of Economics) and listed among EAERE supported events. Search "NAERE 2027" or "Nordic Annual Environmental and Resource Economics Workshop".
series.notes: Free participation in 2026. Extended abstracts (2-3 pages) welcome; completed papers may be preferred.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Portuguese Economic Journal
series.organizer: Portuguese Economic Journal (PEJ), with the hosting Portuguese university
series.site_note: Each edition has its own host-university site, linked from the PEJ 'Upcoming Meeting' button (2026: https://www.ua.pt/pt/pej2026/). Past editions listed at https://pej.iseg.ulisboa.pt/past.html. The PEJ site has an incomplete TLS chain (WebFetch may fail; curl -k works).
series.notes: International generalist conference, first held 2007. Papers in English via Conference Maker; 600-word abstract on cover page.

series.name: Warsaw International Economic Meeting (WIEM)
series.organizer: Faculty of Economic Sciences, University of Warsaw
series.notes: All areas of economics (focus on macro, trade, labour, education, micro, IO, finance, econometrics). Young economists encouraged but not restricted. 2026 fee EUR 200 / PLN 850.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Finnish Economic Association (Kansantaloustieteen päivät)
series.organizer: Finnish Economic Association (Taloustieteellinen Yhdistys)
series.site_note: Calls are posted as news items on the association homepage (e.g. 'Call for papers: 2026 Annual meeting of the Finnish Economic Association').
series.notes: Sessions in English; all areas of economics; abstract submission via online form. 2026 fee EUR 150 (presenting PhD students free).

series.name: Swedish Conference in Economics (Nationalekonomiska konferensen)
series.organizer: Swedish Economic Association (Nationalekonomiska Föreningen) with a host university
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site linked from the association page (2026: https://sites.google.com/view/9th-swedish-conference-in-econ/home).
series.notes: Conference language English; open to graduate students and senior researchers; 2024 edition had no conference fee.

series.name: Biennial Conference of the Czech Economic Society
series.organizer: Czech Economic Society (CES / ČSE)
series.site_note: Call for papers is posted as a PDF poster on the biennial-conference page.
series.notes: Full papers in English by email to conference@cse.cz; all fields of economics and finance; serves as a local job market. 2026: free for CES members registering before 1 Nov, otherwise CZK 1,000.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Norwegian Association of Economists (Forskermøtet)
series.organizer: Samfunnsøkonomene (Norwegian Association of Economists)
series.site_note: Hosted in rotation by Norwegian universities and business schools; the 2026 call and submission form were on Samfunnsøkonomene's event.checkin.no page. Search 'Forskermøtet <year>' or 'Annual meeting of the Norwegian Association of Economists <year>'.
series.notes: All areas of economics including finance; complete sessions welcome; prize for best PhD-student paper. 2025 edition at NHH Bergen.

series.name: NBER Japan Project Meeting
series.organizer: NBER Japan Project; co-sponsored by NBER, Australia-Japan Research Centre (ANU), Center for Advanced Research in Finance (University of Tokyo) and Center on Japanese Economy and Business (Columbia University)
series.site_note: Each year's call has its own NBER page (2027: https://www.nber.org/calls-papers-and-proposals/japan-project-meeting-2027).
series.notes: No set theme: any aspect of the Japanese economy. Travel and hotel covered for one author per paper and discussants.

series.name: Western Regional Science Association (WRSA) Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Western Regional Science Association (WRSA)
series.site_note: Site redirects to https://www.wrsaonline.org/newsite/. Calls are also posted on the RSAI events calendar (regionalscience.org).
series.notes: Full papers only (drafts accepted); presenters also discuss/chair. Registration includes WRSA membership. Tiebout Prize competition has its own deadline.

series.name: Annual Conference on Urban and Regional Economics (CURE)
series.organizer: Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR), International Trade and Regional Economics Programme, with local organisers
series.frequency: Annual (Europe in odd years, USA in even years)
series.site_note: CEPR pages block WebFetch/curl (HTTP 403); read them with a browser. Submissions via CEPR HUB.
series.notes: Only European (odd-year) editions run through CEPR with an open call; US editions (e.g. Philadelphia) have been invitation-only. 2025: LSE, 7-8 Nov.

series.name: ABFER Annual Conference (Labour Economics; Real Estate and Urban Economics; Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs)
series.organizer: Asian Bureau of Finance and Economic Research (ABFER)
series.site_note: Call for papers posted on the annual-conference page (2026 call: https://www.abfer.org/events/abfer-events/annual-conference/417:accfp2026).
series.notes: Multi-program conference, mostly finance; only the Labour Economics, Real Estate and Urban Economics (joint with IREUS) and Tech, Digital Markets and AI programs are in scope. Fee waived for presenters and discussants; capped sponsorship for one author and one discussant per paper.

series.name: EEA-ESEM Congress (EEA Annual Congress and European Summer Meeting of the Econometric Society)
series.organizer: European Economic Association (EEA) and Econometric Society (ES)
series.site_note: Host city rotates. The EEA page links to the congress site https://www.eea-esem-congresses.org/ (reused each year); the Econometric Society event page for each edition posts submission dates first. EEA submissions go through congresscreator.org, ES submissions through Oxford Abstracts.
series.associated_journal: Journal of the European Economic Association; Econometrica
series.notes: Full papers only (no abstracts). One paper per author to each of the EEA and ES sessions; at least one co-author must be a member of the association submitted to. 2026 registration EUR 495 members / EUR 990 non-members. 2027: Prague, 23-27 Aug.

series.name: Royal Economic Society Annual Conference
series.organizer: Royal Economic Society (RES)
series.site_note: Each year has its own event page (e.g. https://res.org.uk/event-listing/res2027/), linked from the conference overview page.
series.typical_deadline: Mid/late January (General Sessions); April (Speed and Poster Sessions)
series.associated_journal: The Economic Journal; The Econometrics Journal
series.notes: Rotates across UK universities. No submission fee; RES membership not required to submit. Abstract plus (draft) paper required. 2027: University of Reading, 28-30 Jun.

series.name: Verein für Socialpolitik Annual Conference (VfS Jahrestagung)
series.organizer: Verein für Socialpolitik (German Economic Association, VfS)
series.site_note: Site shows a cookie wall; choose 'Technically necessary functions'. Each edition has an 'Annual Conference YYYY' page and an 'Open Meeting YYYY' call page.
series.notes: Open Meeting accepts papers and organised sessions from all fields of economics alongside a themed core conference. Held in German-speaking countries. 2027: Hannover, 26-29 Sep (core theme: Geoeconomics).

series.name: Simposio of the Spanish Economic Association (SAEe)
series.organizer: Spanish Economic Association (Asociación Española de Economía, SEA)
series.associated_journal: SERIEs - Journal of the Spanish Economic Association
series.notes: Papers in English via Congress Creator; one paper per participant. Host university in Spain rotates. 2026: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, 16-18 Dec.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Italian Economic Association (SIE RSA)
series.organizer: Società Italiana degli Economisti (Italian Economic Association, SIE)
series.site_note: Each edition's call is posted under the event's page on siecon.org (linked from the home page).
series.typical_deadline: End of April (individual papers); early/mid April (member-organised sessions)
series.notes: Call in English, open to members and non-members; full paper required. Registration includes SIE membership.

series.name: AFSE Annual Congress
series.organizer: Association Française de Science Économique (French Economic Association, AFSE)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own site (e.g. https://afse2026.sciencesconf.org/), linked from the 'Annual Congress' menu on afse.fr.
series.notes: Host city in France rotates. 2027: 75th congress, Strasbourg, 23-25 Jun.

series.name: Irish Economic Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Irish Economic Association (IEA)
series.notes: Full papers (25-min slots), extended abstracts or early drafts (10-min flash talks) and organised sessions accepted (2026 rules). Location in Ireland rotates; 2026 organised by the Central Bank of Ireland in Thurles.

series.name: Scottish Economic Society Annual Conference
series.organizer: Scottish Economic Society (SES)
series.site_note: Each edition has its own Oxford Abstracts site (sesYY.oa-event.com, e.g. ses27 for 2027), linked from scotecon.org.
series.notes: Full manuscript preferred, extended abstract (750 words) accepted; one paper per presenting author; oral and poster formats from 2027. 2027: Heriot-Watt University, Edinburgh, 12-14 Apr.

series.name: Annual Meeting of the Austrian Economic Association (NOeG)
series.organizer: Nationalökonomische Gesellschaft (Austrian Economic Association, NOeG)
series.site_note: Calls are circulated on the noeg-l mailing list (mailman3.wu.ac.at) and on each edition's ConfTool site (e.g. conftool.com/noeg2026).
series.typical_deadline: Spring to early June (7 June in 2026)
series.notes: Host city in Austria rotates; 2026 was a joint SEA-NOeG conference with the Slovak Economic Association at CEU Vienna. 2027: Klagenfurt, 9-10 Sep.

series.name: SSES Annual Congress
series.organizer: Swiss Society of Economics and Statistics (SSES)
series.site_note: Old sgvs.ch URLs redirect to sses.swiss. Each edition has a page sses.swiss/conferences/ssesYYYY/; submissions via Converia.
series.associated_journal: Swiss Journal of Economics and Statistics
series.notes: Each congress has a special theme. Future hosts: 2027 UniDistance Suisse, Brig (17-18 Jun, 'AI and Economics'); 2028 University of Bern; 2029 University of Basel.

series.name: ASSET Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Association of Southern European Economic Theorists (ASSET)
series.site_note: Hosted by a different member institution each year on the host's own site (2026: https://crenoslef.wixsite.com/asset-2026; 2025: AIRESS, UM6P Rabat). Search 'ASSET 2027 annual meeting'.
series.notes: Open to researchers from member and non-member institutions. Some editions are held outside Europe (e.g. Morocco 2025) and are then out of scope.

series.name: European Winter Meeting of the Econometric Society (EWMES)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Open to all (best-paper award limited to authors within two years of PhD). One paper per presenter; at least one author must be an ES member. 2027: Université libre de Bruxelles, 16-18 Dec.

series.name: Japanese Economic Association Spring Meeting
series.organizer: Japanese Economic Association (JEA)
series.notes: Presentations open to JEA members only (non-members must join first; applications via member My Page). English-language submission policy not verified: application-guide PDFs on jeaweb.org redirect and could not be read. Site is mostly Japanese.

series.name: Japanese Economic Association Autumn Meeting
series.organizer: Japanese Economic Association (JEA)
series.notes: Presentations open to JEA members only (non-members must join first; applications via member My Page). English-language submission policy not verified. Site is mostly Japanese.

series.name: Korea's Allied Economic Associations Annual Meeting (경제학 공동학술대회)
series.organizer: Korean Economic Association (KEA) with participating economics associations
series.notes: Here 'kaea' means Korea's Allied Economic Associations, not the Korea-America Economic Association. Paper calls are issued separately by each participating association; largely Korean-language.

series.name: Korean Economic Review (KER) International Conference
series.organizer: Korean Economic Association (KEA)
series.notes: English-language international conference. Each edition also has its own Google Sites page (e.g. sites.google.com/view/ker2026). In 2026 presenters had to be KEA members.

series.name: Korea and the World Economy Conference (AKES International Conference)
series.organizer: Association of Korean Economic Studies (AKES)
series.notes: Venues alternate inside and outside Korea (2025: Aichi Gakuin University, Japan; 2023: Jakarta). Only editions in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG are in scope. The HTTPS site uses a self-signed certificate; use http.

series.name: Taiwan Economic Association Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Taiwan Economic Association (TEA)
series.site_note: No standalone TEA website found. Each year's call is circulated by Taiwanese economics departments (2026: NDHU Economics news) and uses the Academia Sinica ISAS submission system (conference.iis.sinica.edu.tw/surl/tea26). Search 'Taiwan Economic Association Annual Meeting 2027' or '台灣經濟學會 年會 2027'.
series.notes: Host university rotates within Taiwan (2026: National Cheng Kung University, Tainan).

series.name: Hong Kong Economic Association Biennial Conference
series.organizer: Hong Kong Economic Association (HKEA)
series.notes: 12th conference (15-16 Jun 2026) was held at the University of Macau, outside scope; check each edition's venue. cfp_page changes per edition.

series.name: Singapore Economic Review Conference (SERC)
series.organizer: Economic Growth Centre, Nanyang Technological University / The Singapore Economic Review
series.notes: Free submission via Editorial Express; selected papers invited to an SER special issue. Contact serc@ntu.edu.sg. The site still contains some template text and older 2024 wording.

series.name: East Asian Economic Association International Convention
series.organizer: East Asian Economic Association (EAEA)
series.frequency: Biennial historically; 2025 and 2026 held in consecutive years
series.site_note: No permanent EAEA website found. Each convention has its own site (e.g. eaea20.ateneo.edu, eaea21.pfm.gov.kh) and calls are also printed in the Asian Economic Journal. Search 'EAEA 22nd International Convention'.
series.notes: Venue rotates across East and Southeast Asia; only conventions in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG are in scope (2025 Manila and 2026 Siem Reap were out of scope).

series.name: Asian Meetings of the Econometric Society (AMES)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.frequency: Annual (several regional Asian meetings per year)
series.notes: Covers the East & Southeast Asia / Asia main meeting and any Asian meeting held in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG. 2027 Asia Main Meeting: Tokyo (Waseda), 3-5 Aug 2027. The 2027 Asia-China meeting (Wuhan) is out of scope; the 2026 China meeting was held in Hong Kong. ES membership required for submitting authors.

series.name: WEAI International Conference (formerly Pacific Rim Conference)
series.organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI)
series.notes: Asia-Pacific venues rotate; only editions in JP/KR/TW/HK/SG/AU/NZ are in scope. cfp_page changes per edition (look for 'Nth International Conference' on weai.org).

series.name: Australian Conference of Economists (ACE)
series.organizer: Economic Society of Australia (ESA)
series.notes: Hosting rotates among ESA state branches; each edition has its own site (e.g. ace2026.org.au). ACE 2027: Melbourne (RMIT), 6-9 Jul 2027. ACE 2026 fees: AUD 800 non-member early bird.

series.name: New Zealand Association of Economists Annual Conference
series.organizer: New Zealand Association of Economists (NZAE)
series.notes: Abstract-based; full papers required only for prize entries (2026).

series.name: Australasia Meeting of the Econometric Society (ESAM)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Host university rotates within Australia/NZ (2026 Adelaide; 2027 Griffith University, Gold Coast, 1-3 Dec 2027). Submitters must be ES members.

series.name: AEA/ASSA Annual Meeting
series.organizer: American Economic Association (AEA) / Allied Social Science Associations (ASSA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submissions (max. 300 words); at least one author must be an AEA member. Future meetings: Atlanta Jan 7-9, 2028; San Diego Jan 5-7, 2029.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Summer Meeting
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.site_note: Each edition is hosted by a university that may run its own meeting site; the Econometric Society's North America events page links to each edition.
series.notes: Since 2026 the Society's primary North American meeting (previously the Winter Meeting). Submitting author must be an Econometric Society member.

series.name: Econometric Society North American Winter Meeting (at ASSA)
series.organizer: Econometric Society
series.notes: Held as part of the ASSA meeting. At least one co-author must be an Econometric Society member; one paper per presenter. Continuation after the January 2027 edition not yet confirmed (NASM became the primary North American meeting in 2026).

series.name: Southern Economic Association Annual Meeting
series.organizer: Southern Economic Association (SEA)
series.notes: Abstract-only submission; USD 35 fee per individual paper (waived within complete session proposals).

series.name: Western Economic Association International Annual Conference
series.organizer: Western Economic Association International (WEAI)
series.notes: Abstract (350 words) submission requires paying submission + registration fee up front (registration refundable if rejected). WEAI's separate International (Pacific Rim) conference is not covered here.

series.name: Eastern Economic Association Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Eastern Economic Association (EEA)
series.typical_deadline: Early deadline Nov 1; regular deadline Dec 1
series.notes: Submissions via https://eea.meetingsavvy.net/. Often held in New York City, but the venue varies; check the region each year. CSWEP also runs sessions at this meeting.

series.name: Midwest Economics Association Annual Meetings
series.organizer: Midwest Economics Association (MEA)
series.notes: One-page abstract; MEA membership required to submit (membership + submission fee paid at submission).

series.name: Missouri Valley Economic Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Missouri Valley Economic Association (MVEA)
series.notes: Abstract submission via online form; offers in-person and virtual registration. Papers presented are eligible for consideration at the Journal of Economic Insight.

series.name: International Atlantic Economic Conference (North America, fall)
series.organizer: International Atlantic Economic Society (IAES)
series.associated_journal: Atlantic Economic Journal; International Advances in Economic Research
series.notes: Possibly dormant: no conference held since the 96th IAEC (Philadelphia, Oct 2023); the site announces an unscheduled 2026 conference with abstract submission 'coming soon'. iaes.org returns HTTP 403 to simple fetchers (use a browser).

series.name: Canadian Economics Association Annual Conference
series.organizer: Canadian Economics Association (CEA)
series.site_note: Each edition has a page on economics.ca (e.g. https://www.economics.ca/cea-2027).
